## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Tech soft while Healthcare and select Cyclicals/Industrials are rallying, giving a rotation signal; Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing strength: KHC (1W: +9.80% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing cyclical support: HD (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +1.07% | 1M: +16.39%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: DOW (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.88%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -6.45%) BELOW TREND. Technology soft: ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -14.08% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed with short-term weakness: GS (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%) CORRECTION, BLK (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5) — Healthcare-heavy but with Tech and Communication representation.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -14.08% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -6.45%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in semiconductors, software infra and select cyclicals.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: CHTR (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap names (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, TSLA) show 1W up vs 1M down (RECOVERY pattern) — watch for trend confirmation, tactical not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak with clear dispersion: PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND and IBM (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND versus ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Tech: 7/24 positive (Sector Weakness).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed/rotational: V (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, but GS (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%) CORRECTION and BLK (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: Financials: 8/20 positive (Internal Rotation).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Clear leader and defensive/cyclical overlap: JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +10.38%) ABOVE TREND; Sector breadth: Healthcare: 14/17 positive (Sector Strength).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Healthcare leaders (JNJ, LLY, ABBV) and select Industrials/Cyclicals (HD, CAT) as rotation candidates; reduce exposure to lagging semiconductors and software infra (ORCL, QCOM, TXN) until momentum stabilizes. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given Healthcare strength but tech divergences and Financials mixed.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Sector Strength — breadth strong, multiple ABOVE TREND names). BEARISH: Technology and Materials (Sector Weakness — concentrated large 1W declines).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch PANW for follow-through above recent breakout level (ABOVE TREND continuation); monitor ORCL at prior support after sharp selloff (BELOW TREND sign); watch JNJ and LLY to confirm leadership on follow-through above weekly gains (ABOVE TREND continuation).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABBV (+80): AbbVie wins EU backing — ABBV (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MA (+60): merchant-fee settlement progress — MA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. BA (+60): $2B satellite contract — BA (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -6.16%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CME (-50): price-target cut — CME (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. META (-40): regulatory headwinds — META (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. INTC (-45) flagged in news but showing mixed signals across timeframes — monitor for confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. JNJ, LLY, ABBV (all ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength while ORCL, QCOM, TXN are showing weakness. Key risk: Major divergence among large caps (multiple RECOVERY patterns in MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/TSLA) — watch for trend confirmation and sentiment-driven distribution.
